main_text.p: sta , & testimonium ipsi apud turbam perhibitum, usque ad v. 31. tum conquæritur de peruersita- te Scribarum & Pharisæorum, usque ad v. 36. Denique remittit in domo Pharisæi cuiusdam pec- cata mulieri peccatrici.

Pergit Dominus in administratione mune- ris Prophetici docendo & operando: docendo quidem: nam proponit & explicat parabolam de satore, usque ad v. 19. & respondet de matre & fratribus, usque ad v. 22. Operando autem: nam sedat tempestatem maris, usque ad v. 26. & eiicit dæmonia complura ex homine uno, usque ad v. 40. & sanat mulierem laborantem fluxione sanguinis, excitatqueà morte filiam Iaïri.

Capitis noni partes principales sunt duæ: Quædam enim adhuc pertinent ad primam officij prophetici partem principalem, nimirum omnia illa quæ de Christo & discipulis narrantur usque ad v. 51. Quædam ad secundam Ministerij Christi partem referuntur: inde usque ad finem capitis.

Priore parte narrantur ista. 1 Emissio Apostolorum 12. ad prædicandum. 11 Iudicium Herodis de Christo, & studium videndi ipsum, v.7.8.9. 111 Reditus discipulorum, & Christi cum ipsis seceßus, in quo insigne illud miraculum pastionis 5000. hominum per 5. panes & duos pisces edidit: usque ad v. 18. 1 v Christi sciscitatio de iudiciis hominum de se, ut constaret de Apostolorum confessione, quam Petrus omnium nomine edidit: & prædi- ctio[?] passionis suæ, indeque deducta ad constantiam & tolerantiam exhortatio, usque ad v. 28. v Mi-

page.notes: The first word of the page, "sta", is a fragment of the previous page's last word and stays as printed. The catchword "raculum" is printed at the right below the last line, and the word "Miraculum" is completed by it. The reading "prædi- ctio" is uncertain: the letters in the scan are hard to make out, so [?] is placed after it. The word "deducta" is printed with a long-s-like form and is read as "deducta". The italic setting of the list in the last paragraph follows the scan. No signature is visible.
